verdict.rationale: Headless or CI operation is a fair question for an agent-workflow plugin, but the evidence documents no headless, CI, or non-interactive run mode for Superpowers. Its workflow explicitly stops for human approval before implementation. The tmux-driven eval harness only tests the plugin's own skill compliance. Any non-interactive execution would come from the host agent CLI, not from Superpowers, so it earns no credit here.
